name: The Stenchmaster Fart Zone
//: Story Phase 16 (chapter 189): the old sail locker, under the cargo grating midships. A wooden compartment with three portholes on the sea side, made into a designated release room for Grand Stenchmasters by desperate pirates with signs and rope: the release area on the left, the observation point behind a rope on the right, the queue by the door. Not the Fart-Free Zone. Its props (signs, the door's dents, the portholes open or shut, the rules) are its phase16 patch.
